|game_text=Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is that card image ([[:File:VB6-D-revengeofthesith-pre.gif]]); it was on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013, the folder's bulk upload date.
* '''Original''' ([[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6)]]): Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet, official text as of 15 March 2010 (slip 3•10E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"; released 12 March 2010; copy re-made 4 April 2010), page 3, slip 310E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095315/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-10E-Revenge_Of_The_Sith.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 3•10E at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 6 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1263_10">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (to a maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' One change: “to a” is added (“(to a maximum of 8)”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-revengeofthesith-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual6-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). Besides the words, the image differs from the release-sheet slip in one visible way: it prints slip number 3•10 without the E (the release-sheet slip prints 3•10E).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Revenge Of The Sith (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 30)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1263-10-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on Vader. [Coruscant] holograms are lost. Opponent may not add destiny draws to total power or attrition here. While with a Skywalker or Jedi, Vader’s defense value is +2 (maximum of 8) and his immunity to attrition is +2. When Vader leaves table, place Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number, only the E mark at the bottom right. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
